title: Principalization of a finite-colength ideal by point blowups
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, let $T\subseteq X$ be a finite set of closed points such that $\mathcal O_{X,p}$ is regular local of dimension $2$ for every $p\in T$, and let $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ be a quasi-coherent ideal with $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal O_X/\mathcal I)\subseteq T$. There is a finite sequence $X_n\to\cdots\to X_0=X$ of blowups at reduced closed points mapping into $T$ such that $\mathcal I\mathcal O_{X_n}$ is an effective Cartier ideal, meaning locally generated by a nonzerodivisor, and in particular is invertible. The length-zero sequence is permitted. Conventions: [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], [def-weil-regular-scheme], [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], [def-nagata-global-blowup], [def-weil-closed-immersion], [pqf-def-coherent], [def-nagata-effective-cartier-ideal], [def-sc-invertible-module].
